head: pan, SEMS washer, self-tapping
notes: Only source is an auto-service blog (likely auto-written) tying it to a 1965 Malibu instrument panel; Corvette vendors list 9419329 as the 63-67 headlamp switch screw set, no size. Treat as unverified.

sources.title: What size screws are in the Chevy license plate? | AHG Auto Service
sources.quote: The GM #9419329 fastener used on the instrument panel of your 1965 Malibu (and similar Chevy models) is a #10‑16 × 5/8″ Pan‑Head SEMS self‑tapping screw with attached washer
